page_title: ROM 1-0 VER | AS Roma v Verona 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) brings an opponent down and Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. AS Roma will take a free kick near the side line.
89' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
88' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
86' Tomas Suslov (Verona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball has crossed the sideline. AS Roma are taking a throw-in.
86' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) replacing Eldor Shomurodov.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) for Matias Soule.
80' Substitution. Ondrej Duda will be replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
80' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Nicolas Valentini is replaced by Martin Frese (Verona).
79' Amin Sarr (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Mosquera leaves the pitch and Cheikh Niasse (Verona) comes on.
75' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
72' A terrific attempt by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
71' Suat Serdar (Verona) trips an opposition player and Luca Pairetto signals a foul. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Alexis Saelemaekers and he is replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
69' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
68' The free kick from long range, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) makes a slide tackle, but referee Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
64' Flag up against Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
63' That's the end of the game for Tommaso Baldanzi, who is replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
62' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Pawel Dawidowicz will be replaced by Suat Serdar (Verona).
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Antoine Bernede will be replaced by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
57' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) receives a yellow card.
53' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.

53' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
52' Verona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
50' Amin Sarr (Verona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
49' Antoine Bernede (Verona) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
48' The free kick from long range, taken by AS Roma, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
46' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Verona.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Luca Pairetto has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The corner from Alexis Saelemaekers evades the keeper, but Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just wide of the right post.
45' The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' A clumsy foul by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. AS Roma win a free kick.
40' Verona couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
38' The free kick into the penalty area from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is cleared.
38' Matias Soule (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
36' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
36' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
35' The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
32' Ondrej Duda (Verona) jumps into a tackle and Luca Pairetto signals a foul. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
32' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Verona in a dangerous position.
30' It's a nice effort by Daniel Mosquera (Verona) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Mile Svilar. Easy save.
25' Poor challenge! Ondrej Duda (Verona) is penalised for tripping and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.

23' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
18' The corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is cleared away by the defence.
16' None of the AS Roma players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
15' Matias Soule (AS Roma) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Lorenzo Montipo sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
12' Antoine Bernede (Verona) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
12' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Antoine Bernede (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
9' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
7' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) brings his opponent down. Luca Pairetto has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma have a free kick.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Matias Soule. The score is 1:0.
2' Amin Sarr (Verona) is adjudged offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Pairetto.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
